boss.apt_text:
🩸 **Battle ability**
**🩸 Berserker** — +30% ATK, but +25% damage taken.
**🛡️ Guardian** — -30% damage taken, -15% ATK. Intercepts devastating blows instead of allies and covers the team (-10% area damage).
**💚 Healer** — heals the most wounded ally by +8% HP/turn, -15% ATK.
**⚔️ Duelist** — elemental advantage ×1.5 (instead of ×1.25).
**💀 Executioner** — +40% ATK while the boss is enraged (<50% HP).

Pick one below.
